name: Op-Amp Gain Tool
blurb: gain, offset and bandwidth of inverting and non-inverting stages
intro: For a voltage-feedback op-amp with a single-pole response: the signal gain, the noise gain 1 + Rf/Rg that sets bandwidth (GBW / noise gain) and multiplies the offset, the output offset from Vos and bias currents, and the slew-rate limit for your signal. Give a target gain to get a standard feedback resistor.

inputs.label: Target gain (optional)
inputs.help: Signed for inverting (−4.7). Gives the standard Rf for your Rg.

inputs.label: Resistance at + input
inputs.help: Non-inverting: the source resistance. Inverting: the resistor from + to ground (Rf‖Rg cancels bias current).

inputs.label: Output headroom to each rail
inputs.help: Rail-to-rail output ≈ 0.05–0.2 V; classic op-amps 1.5–2 V.

examples.title: ×11 non-inverting stage with a 1 MHz op-amp on ±5 V
Inverting gain −4.7 from a 10 kΩ input, rail-to-rail CMOS op-amp

usage: Give cfg (noninv or inv), Rf and Rg in ohms, optionally a target gain (signed for inverting) and the resistor series, the op-amp's GBW in Hz, slew rate in V/µs, Vos in µV, bias and offset currents in nA, the resistance at the + input in ohms, the input peak voltage in V, the highest signal frequency in Hz, the supply rails in V and the output headroom in V. It returns signal and noise gain, the −3 dB bandwidth, gain error and phase at the signal frequency, the worst-case output offset split into its causes, the full-power bandwidth, whether the output clips, and a standard Rf for the target gain; result.stage holds the same figures as plain numbers, with the Bode data (closed-loop and open-loop gain against frequency). Use it to size or check a simple op-amp gain stage.
sources: G = 1 + Rf/Rg (non-inverting), −Rf/Rg (inverting); noise gain NG = 1 + Rf/Rg; f−3dB = GBW/NG for a single-pole, voltage-feedback op-amp - Analog Devices MT-033 'Voltage feedback op amp gain and bandwidth'
Output offset = NG·Vos + Ib·(Rf − NG·Rp) + ½·Ios·(Rf + NG·Rp); Rp = Rf‖Rg cancels the bias term - Analog Devices MT-037 'Op amp input offset voltage' and MT-038 'Op amp input bias current'
Full-power bandwidth = SR / (2π·Vout,peak) - TI SLOA011 'Understanding operational amplifier specifications'
